text: Working with EA Pro Painters was great experience. I hired EA for exterior painting of two buildings and a big pavilion on Greens Road this summer. It was a pleasure working with Alfredo. He was very helpful by updating me about the progress and problems that arose during the project!

text: They were prompt and efficient and did a great job. They spotted some bad siding and repaired it at a fair price. Erlin and his team were a joy to work with!

text: Edwin and team painted our exterior. I had very positive experience working with them. They are very responsive for the feedback and completed the work as planned without any issues.

text: We had the exterior house painted and deck stained by EA Pro Painting and we're very pleased with the work Edwin and his team did. Great communication throughout the process, very thorough job and a reasonable price too. Highly recommend.

text: I needed a fast turnaround, quality work, and reasonable cost on a smaller exterior painting job. Edwin and Oleg came through, scheduling and completing the work in a timely way -- and it looks great. I would consider them for my next (and larger) project.

text: Octavia and Carlos working with EA Pro Painting llc, completed an excellent job painting our 2 story home in a very timely manner. They were both here each day working tirelessly for many hours each day making sure the job was professionaly completed and obviously took great care in their workmanship. We have highly recommended them to our family and friends. Thanks for a job well done!
name: Susan P.

text: Edwin and his crew did an excellent job painting the exterior of our 2 story house. Edwin was very personable to work with and was always available anytime we had any questions regarding our painting job. We have highly recommended EA Pro painters to our family and friends.

text: Vlad and his team were super helpful when choosing our paint colors. Thank you for coming with us to Sherwin Williams and helping us out! I really appreciate your time and expertise.

text: Highly recommend EA. Best quote and quality on the Eastside. Huge thanks to Erik for the initial quote, Edwin for great project management, and Mario and his crew for the incredible work.

text: If you are seeking to hire a group of experienced professionals who will do their job exactly as you wish them to, then your search is over. Our experience with the painters who came was very positive, coming punctually and giving us some useful advice. I highly recommend this group of people to others, and we will definitely contact them again in the future.
name: James Dierking

text: My new small addition got an interesting paint job. 500 square feet but 12 feet high. I added some glitter on request. lol. Very professional and neat. They caulked and sealed it perfectly. Heat made it shrink, and they came out again to re-caulk and paint it. Excellent work. Great price.
name: Nicole Brewton

text: Shoutout to EA Pro Painters for a fantastic job on our exterior painting! Edwin was super helpful with advice and made sure all our concerns were addressed. Ramiro and his crew were great to work with and did high-quality work. Definitely give them a call!
name: Sandy

text: The team was friendly, professional, and a joy to work with. Upon asking if they could handle a few additional touch-ups at the end of the job, they readily obliged and completed everything straightaway. They did a wonderful job, and I greatly appreciated their attention to detail and their willingness to get things done right for me.
name: Kyle Clayton

text: Andrey and his Team did a great job painting my kitchen cabinets. Everything from beginning to end went perfectly smoothly. Rico was fast to respond to my first inquiry. When he came for the estimate, he gave me all the information I needed by answering all my questions. They arrived at the scheduled time, finished on schedule, and most importantly, did an amazing job! I highly recommend EA, in particular, Ricardo and his Team!
name: Arthur Bryan

text: They were painters and treated my house like it was theirs. They painted the whole house very well. After the painting was finished, they toured the whole house to ensure that everything was painted as required. They touched up those areas of the house that I specified.
name: Adaline Buske

text: EA Pro Painters delivered an exceptional experience, and I want to especially recognize Edwin and Oleg for their professionalism. They were consistently responsive, detailed in every step of the process, and kept me updated on the status throughout the project. Their prep work was thorough. The final result looks great. The entire experience felt organized. Highly recommend EA Pro Painters, especially Edwin and Oleg, for anyone who wants quality work and professionalism.
name: Carol Gong
